question: Evaluate commercial Irish potato production in Nakuru County (Molo highland area), examining wholesale 50kg bag prices, certified Shangi seed tuber costs, and rainfall cessation frost risks.

decision.note: Evidence checklist coverage, not a probability of success, crop yield, or profitability.

rationale: Nexus reviewed 2 record(s) across 2 named source(s). The evidence sufficiency status is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE (coverage score 75/100). No explicit encoded contradictions were found. Verify local water abstraction quotas, certified input costs, and binding buyer terms before committing capital.

evidence.source_name: National Potato Council of Kenya (NPCK) Market Watch
evidence.title: Nakuru & Molo Irish potato wholesale bag prices
evidence.claim: A 50kg bag of Shangi variety wholesale in Nakuru traded at 2,400-3,200 KES (48-64 KES/kg) during off-season.
evidence.detail: Commercial production in Molo and Mau Narok yields 80-120 bags/acre. Seed tuber cost (certified Shangi at 3,800 KES/bag, 12-14 bags required per acre) accounts for nearly 40% of initial operating capital.
quality_flags: Seed tuber quality directly dictates bacterial wilt incidence.

evidence.source_name: Kenya Meteorological Department - Rift Valley Agrometeorology
evidence.title: Nakuru highland frost and rainfall cessation outlook
evidence.claim: Highland frost events in late November and unpredictable rainfall cessation pose risks to late-planted tubers.
evidence.detail: Cold-tolerant varieties and early-October planting mitigate frost damage; unseasonal rains during harvest double post-harvest rot losses in ambient on-farm storage.

missing_information: Confirm the source dates and grading methodology for wholesale price claims.

Obtain written offtake terms or binding purchase agreements before transplanting.
next_actions: Inspect the cited source URLs and verify date and grade relevance to Kirinyaga.
Obtain current local supplier quotations for drip irrigation and certified seed.
Re-run the investigation once farm-specific cost and water permits are established.
